subject: Follow-up: Incident analysis, actions & verification for GreenBridge outage
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie.t@greenbridge.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Incident analysis, actions & verification for GreenBridge outage

Jamie —

Thanks again for your patience while we completed our internal analysis. Attached is a concise RCA and the action plan we committed to during the call. Summary highlights below, and full timeline + evidence is in the attached document.

Executive RCA (TL;DR)
- Root cause: A regression in our cache-coordination layer combined with a stale routing table caused a small set of dedicated-pool requests for your account to be routed to a partially-warmed node cluster; that resulted in elevated tail latency and token drops for ~18 minutes.
- Scope: Approx. 1.5% of your requests between 02:17–02:35 UTC experienced increased latency and 0.03% experienced truncated responses. No customer data was exfiltrated; logs indicate no unauthorized access.
- User impact: Intermittent API timeouts and truncated model outputs for a small percentage of calls in a narrow time window.

Immediate actions we have completed
1) Hotfix deployed (02:45 UTC) — roll-forward of cache-coordination patch and routing-table refresh.
2) Replayed traffic to verify KV-cache warmup (03:10 UTC).
3) Manual verification of request correctness for a sampled set (03:45 UTC).

Planned mitigations and owners (short horizon)
- Implement automated routing-table validation during rollouts — Owner: Hannah Schmitt; ETA: 2028-05-21
- Add end-to-end synthetic traffic checks for dedicated pools — Owner: Marissa Cole; ETA: 2028-05-28
- Extended retention of request traces for 14 days for accounts on Dedicated — Owner: Neha Kapoor; ETA: 2028-05-18

Attachments included:
- greenbridge_rca_20280514.pdf (full timeline, evidence traces)
- action_owners_spreadsheet.xlsx (owners, due dates)
- evidence_trace_log.txt (sanitized request ids and short hashes)

Verification we need from GreenBridge
- Confirm whether your side observed the same window for errors in your dashboards (we've provided sample request ids in evidence_trace_log.txt).
- If possible, share a short set of affected request ids from your logs for cross-correlation; we will treat these as evidence-only and rotate any sensitive identifiers.

Next steps
- We'll schedule a short verification call (30 min) next week to walk the checklist and confirm mitigations. Suggested slots: Wed 05/16 10:00–11:00 PDT or Thu 05/17 14:00–15:00 PDT. Please tell us what works.

Appreciate the partnership — apologies again for the disruption.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: greenbridge_rca_20280514.pdf (PDF, 880 KB)]
[Attachment: action_owners_spreadsheet.xlsx (Excel, 24 KB)]

From: Jamie Torres <jamie.t@greenbridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-support@greenbridge.com
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Incident analysis, actions & verification for GreenBridge outage

Karthik —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for the clear summary. A couple of points from our side:

1) We saw the same spike in retries and a small burst of 504s in our logs starting ~02:18 UTC and winding down by ~02:37 UTC. I attached one of our sample request ids to this reply.
2) Two questions:
  - Can you confirm no persisted customer payloads were truncated in storage (we only saw truncated responses in the API layer)?
  - Do you have an expected timeline for the routing-table validation work (we'd prefer that to be in place before your next large rollout).

We can do Wed 05/16 10:00 PDT for the verification call. Please send a calendar invite.

—Jamie
Jamie Torres
Director of Platform Engineering
GreenBridge Capital
[Attachment: gb_sample_request_id.txt (text, 1 KB)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie.t@greenbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Incident analysis, actions & verification for GreenBridge outage

Jamie —

Appreciate the sample id — we correlated it successfully against our traces and confirmed it matches one of the truncated responses recorded. A few clarifications:

- No persisted customer payloads were truncated in storage. The truncation occurred in-flight at the inference response buffer; downstream storage (S3/equivalent) shows full artifacts for any requests that were persisted. We include the relevant check-sums in the evidence_trace_log.txt.

- Routing-table validation timeline: We've marked this as a high-priority mitigation. Work breakdown:
  a) Short-term (automated preflight check that rejects rollouts when table mismatch detected) — prototype by 2028-05-18, rollout to staging 2028-05-19, GA to production 2028-05-21.
  b) Medium-term (continuous invariants monitoring + alerts) — design complete 2028-06-04, rollout by end of June.

Verification steps for GreenBridge (what we'd like you to check during the Wed 10:00 PDT call)
1) Confirm that the sample request ids from our evidence set show truncated responses in your dashboards (we'll provide the same sample ids on the call).
2) Validate that your retry patterns normalized after 02:45 UTC (we expect a clear drop once hotfix cleared the staging cluster).
3) Optional: we can run a short co-observed synthetic replay during the call to show cache warmup behavior; requires a small whitelisted IP from your side.

I've uploaded an action tracker and turned on longer trace retention for your account for the next 14 days — link is in the postmortem doc. We'll also import your sample id into our cross-correlation tool and share the sanitized trace snippet on the call.

Karthik will send the calendar invite.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evidence_trace_log.txt (text, 12 KB)]

From: Jamie Torres <jamie.t@greenbridge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Thanks Hannah — that all sounds good.

We've accepted the calendar invite for Wed 05/16 10:00 PDT. We'll bring a couple engineers and one of our compliance leads to confirm the retention and the sanitized trace exchange. Please include any short runbook checks we can run on our end during the call.

Appreciate how transparent the team has been. Looking forward to the verification run.

—Jamie
Jamie Torres
Director of Platform Engineering
GreenBridge Capital
